messages:
Alex: FYI, I'm onboarding PartnerCo connector. They asked us to open outbound to their collector IP. Quick security check: is outbound to external partners allowed or should we require VPC peering/VPN? PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/512

Ops-bot: Reminder: external partner egress needs documented business justification + sec approval. Use #security-approvals template.

Priyanka: @Alex please post the exact IP ranges and ports. Also state whether data includes PII.

Alex: Partner sent 203.0.113.0/25. Ports: 443 (ingest), 5432 (db replication). Data contains analytics events; might include user identifiers.

Sam: We can permit egress but only from a dedicated egress subnet that uses the shared NAT and a restricted egress security group. Don't route from app worker subnets directly. Example SG:

```
Egress-SG:
  allowed_dest: 203.0.113.0/25
  allowed_ports: [443,5432]
  source: subnet-10-20-egress
```

Kyle: Also ensure request/response payloads are redacted before logging. If events may include PII, add a redaction filter at the edge (API GW/Lambda) to mask email/ssn/credit_card fields.

Alex: Draft redaction config:

```
redaction:
  json_paths: ["$.user.email","$.user.ssn","$.payment.card_number"]
  mode: mask
```

Priyanka: Security asks: 1) Confirm egress path uses NAT + egress SG; no inbound access to private subnets. 2) Open SEC ticket with justification + retention/PII handling.

Sam: I'll provision the egress subnet and SG. We'll NAT through nat-shared-usw2-1. Tagging SRE for smoke test.

SRE-oncall: Checklist: validate flow, run connectivity smoke, ensure CloudTrail logs capture egress events only, validate KMS usage for stored data. Ping when ready and I'll run tests.

Alex: Created ticket SEC-932: https://issues.redwood/SEC-932 — includes justification and redaction plan.

Priyanka: Once approved, I need the infra diff showing egress SG, the applied redaction config, and CloudTrail/DataAccess logging enabled.

Sam: Note: if partner expects mutual TLS for DB, require mTLS and document cert exchange in the approval.

Kyle: Also redact Authorization/JWT headers in logs.

Alex: Will update SEC-932 and the PR with the diffs. Plan: infra today, partner validation tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
